cohort: 412 adolescents with overweight (BMI ≥ p85), aged 10-18 years, followed at a Pediatric Obesity Clinic
finding: The study found that cesarean section was associated with a lower age of overweight onset, birth weight was positively associated with BMI z-score and waist circumference, and overweight duration was the best predictor of BMI z-score.
mod_finding: Adolescents born by cesarean section (CS) showed a lower age of overweight onset compared to other methods of delivery.
